### 4. Scored parameters
(a) Haul-off line (book_mold_disposal_772b05b2): service_date = latest drywall/insulation removal date = **2026-09-22**.
Computation doc: loads = ceil((96+48)/160) = 1 × tier debris disposal fee (Standard 214.00) = 214.00 (fall-back), + every charge added to the line, round once.
- Bagging streams (doc "Bagging Streams and Roll-Off Loads"): both kinds booked -> ceil(96/160)=1 + ceil(48/120)=1 = 2 loads.
- Debris class (doc "Debris Class and Per-Load Haul Fees"): water category_3 -> 289.00 per load -> 578.00.
- Trip charge (doc "Debris Haul Trip Charges"): latest drywall 09-21 ≠ latest insulation 09-22 -> +150.00.
- Wet debris (doc "Wet Debris Charges After Early-Released Drying"): customer_release, 1 monitoring_visit line (< 2) -> +110.00.
Amount = 578 + 150 + 110 = **838.00**. Fall-back 214.00.

(b) Insured's own share (pay_mold_insured_share_5816092f, payment_amount):
Computation doc rule: share = charge total − customer payments; combination: write-downs off both totals; other-coverage amount off the mold-covered total (floor 0); remainder capped at the coverage limit; carrier-payable = capped + other coverage; share = charge total − write-downs − carrier-payable − customer payments, floor 0, round once.
- Charge total after the haul-off: existing lines 8628.56 (balance 7099.66 + payment 1528.90 checks) + 838.00 = 9466.56. Every line is a remediation scope (event mold_remediation_charge), equipment day or clearance fee line -> mold-covered total 9466.56.
- Coverage limit (doc "Carrier Coverage Limit"): approved, arrangement accepting direct carrier payments -> 5000.00. CONDITIONAL: whether Carrier Program Claim Billing "accepts carrier payments issued directly to the company" is an Insurance Claim Services arrangement property not stated in any published doc (claims docs not yet published); taken as yes (carrier_receivable 11331.79 = 12480 − 337.01 − 811.20 on the file).
- Declined-line write-down (doc "Write-Down of Carrier-Declined Lines"): water job linked to the same file -> 337.01 × 9466.56/12480 = 255.636… -> 255.64. CONDITIONAL on "arrangement never bills declined lines" (claims charter).
- Program write-down (doc "Carrier Program Price Write-Down"): write-offs exist (811.20) -> 811.20 × 9466.56/12480 = 615.326… -> 615.33. CONDITIONAL on "arrangement writes off carrier program price adjustments" (claims charter).
- Ordinance or law (doc "Ordinance or Law Coverage of Regulated-Material Lines"): approved, asbestos_sampling 240.00 + lead_safe_setup 345.00 = 585.00 <= limit 2500.00 -> 585.00.
- Mold-covered after write-downs and other coverage: 9466.56 − 255.64 − 615.33 − 585.00 = 8010.59 -> capped 5000.00; carrier-payable 5585.00.
- Share = 9466.56 − 255.64 − 615.33 − 5585.00 − 1528.90 = **1481.69**; payment_method **ach**.
- Fall-back (computation doc only): 9466.56 − 1528.90 = 7937.66 (or 7313.66 with the haul-off at its own fall-back). Differs.
- Deductible excluded ("never part of the share").

find_customers -> find_mold_jobs/charges/payments, find_water_jobs/charges, find_claims_files/approvals -> unlock + call book_mold_disposal_772b05b2 {cd426fed-…, 2026-09-22, 838.00} (agent) -> unlock_user_discoverable_tool pay_mold_insured_share_5816092f; customer calls {cd426fed-…, 1481.69, ach}. ### 6. Problem tree
- Root: pay own share (customer-owned).
- Hop A — **state-derived**: hub sentence "not worked out until the job's charge lines carry the bagged debris haul-off owed for the drywall or insulation removed" + find_mold_charges (drywall/insulation removal lines, no debris_disposal) -> KB_search with the records' words ("debris haul-off drywall insulation") -> "Bagged Debris Haul-Off on Mold Remediation Jobs" ("Every Mold Remediation job with drywall or insulation removal lines carries one bagged debris haul-off line") with its own booking tool. That hub states no prerequisite of its own. Order: haul-off -> share payment.
- No pre-solved hop.

### Counter-proofs
- "Only take the payment": the share "is not worked out until" the haul-off line exists; and a share figured without it would understate the charge total.
- Closest alternatives: deductible excluded explicitly; the declined/program write-downs use the fraction tier (water job linked; write-offs exist), not the whole-total / percentage tiers; O&L not capped (585 <= 2500); coverage cap binds (8010.59 > 5000), so the order of write-downs vs. cap is immaterial here; roll-off tier excluded (insulation present); trip 75 excluded (dates differ).
- Open/conditional: the three arrangement properties of Carrier Program Claim Billing live in the unpublished Insurance Claim Services corpus; if they read otherwise the share changes materially (e.g. coverage limit 0.00 -> 6481.69). Recorded as conditional, not RED.
